name: Sägerhof
beschreibung: The Sägerhof is a traditional inn in the heart of Tirol, nestled in a picturesque mountain landscape. The cozy atmosphere combines alpine tradition with modern comfort. Guests can expect typical Tiroler cuisine, comfortable rooms, and the opportunity to explore the surrounding nature on hikes or walks. The inn serves as an ideal starting point for day trips into the mountains and offers a quiet retreat away from the hustle and bustle.
